judged_text: Destinations without a credentialId are broken end-to-end: Google's `find(cal => cal.credentialId === credentialId)` never matches in the fallback branch, so events are silently created on `'primary'` instead of the user's configured destination calendar, and `createEvent(c, event)` is called without the new `externalId` param so the stored booking reference has `externalCalendarId: null` — making these bookings created on the wrong calendar and impossible to update/delete by reference.

adjudication.rationale: The diff makes `destinationCalendar` an array and changes GoogleCalendarService `createEvent` to pick the target calendar via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`, falling back to `"primary"` when no match is found. In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, the fallback branch for destinations **without** `credentialId` calls `createEvent(c, event)` (no `externalId` passed) for credentials matching `destination.integration`, but those destination objects may not have `credentialId`, so Google’s `.find(...)` won’t match and events will be inserted into `primary` rather than the configured `destination.externalId`. Additionally, since `CalendarManager.createEvent` now returns `externalId` and `EventManager` stores booking references using `result.externalId`, omitting the `externalId` argument in this fallback branch means references will not carry the correct `externalCalendarId`, impairing later update/delete by reference.
